title: Local mailbox append API should bound sender_name and reject NUL in display metadata
outcome: Low from Architect1's ruling on M4 increment 2's r1 repairs (note a5a8f1077e7f491d9b9ca5588eae116e on w-01da81a029e7; TermAl mailbox 2a27fd51 #868), filed by Termal::Fable2. It is in M2 scope, not this increment. The local mailbox append API accepts a topic containing NUL and an unbounded sender_name. M4 increment 2 now normalizes the wake's display copies deterministically, so the remote wake path is safe, but the append API itself should bound sender_name and reject NUL (and other control characters as decided) at the source, with a named refusal, so bad metadata never enters the mailbox store.
acceptance: The local mailbox append API refuses a topic or sender_name containing NUL, and a sender_name above a documented byte bound, with a named validation error and nothing appended; tests cover acceptance at the bound, refusal above it, and refusal of NUL. Existing valid appends are unchanged.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact input with an independent Codex plus Claude review pair and no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
